repos.name: DiogoS7.github.io
repos.summary: An interactive personal CV website that visualizes career milestones through a solar-system-themed canvas animation.
highlights: Features an 'Ask my CV' terminal powered by Cloudflare Workers AI to answer questions about professional experience.
Uses a GitHub Action to automatically generate AI-written repository cards via README analysis.
Includes skill-based project filtering and a responsive design with light and dark themes.
Built without frameworks or build steps using vanilla web technologies.

repos.name: Houston
repos.description: Houston, we have a solution. A consulting delivery platform built on Power Apps, Power Automate and Power BI.
repos.source: e9c99a431d2127f62b64937249ca5246fc7ba4e7|Houston, we have a solution. A consulting delivery platform built on Power Apps, Power Automate and Power BI.|
repos.summary: A consulting delivery platform designed to manage the full engagement lifecycle, including staffing, scoping, and post-go-live support.
highlights: Includes modules for consultant staffing, skills matrix tracking, and incident management with SLAs
Features automated timesheet approval flows and proactive skill-gap alerts
Integrates embedded Power BI analytics for utilization and bench forecasting

repos.name: dronyDeliv
repos.description: Drone network management, layered on a package delivery network, built in Python
repos.source: b99e391421d6e6e66630c20d90483066b5bb5e36|Drone network management, layered on a package delivery network, built in Python|
repos.summary: A command-line scheduler for managing a drone delivery fleet and parcel orders.
highlights: Assigns drones to parcels based on zone, availability, autonomy, and weight capacity.
Generates updated fleet states and delivery timetables from input files.
Refactored into a tested, installable Python package with CI integration.

repos.name: Launchpad
repos.description: Employee onboarding app on Salesforce: BA documentation, data model, Flows and Agentforce
repos.source: 065c523b5d41308b51b985e1244a9c70d729f547|Employee onboarding app on Salesforce: BA documentation, data model, Flows and Agentforce|
repos.summary: A Salesforce-based employee onboarding application designed to automate task assignment, role preparation, and progress tracking for IT consultancy firms.
highlights: End-to-end business analysis including AS-IS/TO-BE process mapping and requirements traceability.
All business logic is declarative (no Apex): record-triggered Flows and validation rules.
Two custom Lightning Web Components, built without Apex, for real-time KPI monitoring and visual progress tracking.
Includes a full documentation suite with user stories, acceptance criteria, and data models.

repos.name: Django-CRM
repos.description: Customer relationship manager built with Django
repos.summary: A customer relationship management system designed to track sales pipelines, customer records, and interaction histories.
highlights: Features a dashboard with pipeline breakdowns, activity timelines, and stage tracking.
Includes automated testing for core workflows and access control via GitHub Actions.
Implements secure configuration using environment variables and protected destructive actions.
Supports SQLite and MySQL databases through Django ORM.
